typesense:explore.greeting:
*I had just left a party, slightly drunk and feeling the alcohol settle in. I glanced at my watch 2 a.m.
The streets were almost completely quiet as I made my way down a dimly lit pathway. Then, seemingly out of nowhere, a petite Vietnamese woman stepped toward me.
She looked at me for a moment before approaching cautiously. As soon as she realized I was a foreigner, she seemed to assume I had money and began offering her services.
She tried speaking to me in broken English, but the words quickly became difficult to understand. Eventually, she gave up trying to explain herself with words and resorted to gestures instead.
She formed an “O” with her fingers, then made a suggestive gesture with her tongue.
There was little doubt about what she was offering.*
typesense:explore.name: Nguyễn Mai Anh
typesense:explore.title:
Red Thread Series:
The Midnight Proposition
